855-5254-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
855-5254-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
855-5254-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist

3899-7936--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3899-7936--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3175-4247-5617.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1170-2921-4985-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2921-4985-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

997-1011-2728-4153.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
997-1011-2728-4153.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
997-1011-2728-4153.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 4.

4222-5268-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it, adding {U}.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Pestered Wellguard.
Repeat.

360-3375-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
360-3375-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1417-1580-2292-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5957-6289.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

457-1594-1792-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1594-1792-4404.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Helm of Awakening.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

178-206-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-206-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2113-3713-5078-6766.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

104-2034-3129-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-2034-3129-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1308-4365-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
1308-4365-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Mondrak and Anointed Procession.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
1308-4365-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

643-1486-1753-7014.description:
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat.
643-1486-1753-7014.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1856-2034-3490-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1856-2034-3490-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers, pairing it and the Servo.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

3086-3175-5686.description:
Cast Lagrella by paying {G}{W}{U}
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lagrella.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it and Lagrella triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities.

575-1215-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-1215-5971.description:
Activate Hope of Ghirapur by sacrificing it.
When Hope of Ghirapur dies, Yedora triggers, returning Hope of Ghirapur from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Hope of Ghirapur enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hope of Ghirapur by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Hope of Ghirapur face-up.
Resolve the Hope of Ghirapur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1887-2583-5668-5870.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more charge counters on it

617-2593-4235.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Astral Cornucopia.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-5641-5870.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-3719-4089-5326.notablePrerequisites: Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore has a power of at least 2.
1912-3719-4089-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

277-579-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-579-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

659-2232-3338-3652.notablePrerequisites: Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
659-2232-3338-3652.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Goblin creature token.
When the Goblin(s) enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Ornithopter to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining triggers, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.

239-1763-2092-4385.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
239-1763-2092-4385.description:
Activate Silver Queen by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate the Sliver token by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1365-2198-2527-5256-5294.easyPrerequisites:
Deceiver Exarch doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vohar doesn't have summoning sickness.
1365-2198-2527-5256-5294.description:
Activate Vohar's first ability by tapping it.
Vohar triggers, giving creatures you control that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Vohar ability from step 1, causing you to loot.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Deceiver Exarch persist until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Vohar.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

2034-2104-2493-5140.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kenrith's last ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Archaeomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

112-2304-4872.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}.
Arcane Bombardment triggers, exiling an instant or sorcery at random from your graveyard, and casting a copy of Time Warp without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

176-2438-4875.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-2438-4875.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat.

1636-2113-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2113-3590.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Karametra's Favor ability by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
